parameters.subject: ={{ "How did we do? " + $('Verify signature').first().json.data.title }}
parameters.text:
=Hi,

Your ticket "{{ $('Verify signature').first().json.data.title }}" was marked resolved.
Please open it and rate your support experience:
http://localhost:8080/tickets/{{ $('Verify signature').first().json.data.ticketId }}

If the problem is not fixed, reply on the ticket.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: "resolution-followup", eventId: $("Verify signature").first().json.eventId, ticketId: $("Verify signature").first().json.data.ticketId, status: "success", startedAt: $("Verify signature").first().json.startedAt, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ workflow: "resolution-followup", eventId: $("Verify signature").first().json.eventId, ticketId: $("Verify signature").first().json.data.ticketId, status: "failure", errorSummary: (typeof $json.error === "string" ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || "Unknown error")).slice(0, 300), startedAt: $("Verify signature").first().json.startedAt, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}
